q: What amenities does Bayside Park have?
a: Bayside Park has a basketball half court, playground, picnic areas, walking paths, open green lawns, and on-site parking. The City resurfaced the basketball court as part of the 2022-2024 $6M parks program.

q: Can I reserve the basketball court or picnic area at Bayside Park?
a: Yes. The City's ActiveCommunities reservation system lists the Bayside basketball half court as a reservable facility. Picnic shelters and patios citywide can be reserved online via the Parks & Community Services reservation page.

q: What is the size of Bayside Park?
a: Bayside Park is approximately 2.2 acres, making it a small neighborhood-scale park rather than a destination sports complex.
Bayside Park is open daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM (per Apple Maps). The City of Moreno Valley lists all city parks as open 7 AM - 10 PM; the 8 AM start is the more specific listing for this park.

q: Has Bayside Park been recently upgraded?
a: Yes. Bayside was included in the City of Moreno Valley's $6M Parks Rehabilitation & Refurbishment Program, approved October 18, 2022. Upgrades completed at Bayside included basketball court resurfacing, along with parking lot, playground, and restroom improvements citywide (program completed summer 2024).

q: Where is Bayside Park located in Moreno Valley?
a: Bayside Park is at 24435 Bay Avenue, 92553, in east Moreno Valley about a mile north of Alessandro Boulevard near Indian Street. It is roughly 8 miles from Lake Perris State Recreation Area and serves the Bay Avenue residential neighborhood.

q: What wildlife might I see at Bayside Park?
a: Wildlife commonly reported at Bayside includes ducks, geese, herons, squirrels, and rabbits.
